definitions.gloss: airtight container; sealed container; hermetically sealed vessel
definitions.explanation: a container designed to be completely sealed to prevent air, moisture, or other substances from getting in or out

examples.japanese: {食品|しょくひん}は{密閉容器|みっぺいようき}に{入|い}れて{保存|ほぞん}する。
examples.english: Store food in an airtight container.

examples.japanese: {残|のこ}ったスープを{密閉容器|みっぺいようき}に{移|うつ}して{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}に{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I transferred the leftover soup to an airtight container and put it in the fridge.

examples.japanese: {湿気|しっけ}に{弱|よわ}い{薬|くすり}は、{密閉容器|みっぺいようき}に{保管|ほかん}しないと{品質|ひんしつ}が{落|お}ちてしまう。
examples.english: Medicines that are sensitive to moisture will lose quality if not stored in a sealed container.

notes:
Composed of {密閉|みっぺい} (hermetic sealing; airtight closure) + {容器|ようき} (container; vessel). Used in both everyday contexts (food storage) and technical/industrial contexts (chemical storage, laboratory equipment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {密閉容器|みっぺいようき}に{入|い}れる: to put in an airtight container
- {密閉容器|みっぺいようき}で{保存|ほぞん}する: to store in a sealed container
- {密閉容器|みっぺいようき}に{保管|ほかん}する: to keep in a sealed container
- ガラス{製|せい}{密閉容器|みっぺいようき}: glass airtight container

SIMILAR WORDS:
- タッパー: Tupperware — a colloquial term for plastic food storage containers (often airtight)
- {保存容器|ほぞんようき}: storage container — broader term that may or may not be airtight
- {密封|みっぷう}パック: vacuum-sealed pack — emphasizes vacuum sealing rather than just air-tightness
